corpus_union.note: The fork matrix covers every ROM row in all 20 admitted fixture manifests plus both existing acceptance lists. Expected failure, pass, prior observation and acceptance negative-control labels remain attached as provenance. Fork equality is snapshot-equivalence; it does not replay the original oracle.

contract.case_boundary: deterministic public run budget then save
contract.poison: all serialized storage through the private descriptor visitor while retaining ownership and identity
contract.observer_history: compare target-local battery and rumble counter deltas separately

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original looping DMG-compatible ROM powers pulse/noise/wave, triggers a negative pulse sweep, writes all wave RAM bytes, and witnesses serialized APU and resampler fields at a real public save boundary.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: APU powered; generated channel triggers and wave RAM writes completed before save

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original ROM starts a serial transfer then writes the active transfer register, exposing the deferred unsupported-bus result and its consumed latch at the public save boundary.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: Serial transfer register write returns GBB_STOP_UNSUPPORTED_BUS and consumes the deferred latch

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original 128-bank MBC1 ROM writes upper ROM bank bits and RAM/ROM banking mode before a real public save boundary.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: MBC1 upper bank and RAM/ROM mode writes have executed

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original MBC3 timer/RAM ROM writes seconds/minutes/hours/day/flags, performs the 00-to-01 latch sequence, and advances the subsecond anchor before save.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: RTC register writes and latch edge execute before a timed public save

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original DMG ROM enters STOP; the runner queues a future STOP_WAKE event and forks the stopped boundary.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: stopped && input_event_count > 0 with the queued event kind STOP_WAKE

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original CGB-only ROM arms KEY1 and executes STOP; public boundary is during the resulting speed-switch stall after stop_switch_pending has been consumed.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: double_speed && cpu_stall_kind == GBB_STALL_SPEED_SWITCH && cpu_stall_half_dots > 0 && stop_switch_pending == 0

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original DMG ROM executes invalid opcode D3 and reaches the public lockup result before save.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: locked && lockup_pc/lockup_opcode identify the D3 instruction

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original DMG ROM stops after the EI retirement window while ime_delay is one.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: ime_delay == 1 at public save

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original DMG ROM enables and requests VBlank with IME clear, executes HALT, and saves the resulting halt-bug latch.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: halt_bug == 1 after HALT with enabled pending VBlank and IME clear

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original DMG ROM starts OAM DMA from work RAM; save occurs with DMA active and bytes already copied.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: dma_active && 0 < dma_index < 160

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Starts from the real active OAM-DMA guest boundary, changes only the accepted serialized byte phase, recomputes CRC, and reloads through gbb_load_state.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: dma_active && 0 < dma_index < 160 && dma_phase == 1 after public state load

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Guest setup configures the timer; a relation-valid pending reload is CRC-recomputed into state and admitted by the public loader for future continuation.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: timer_reload_pending && 0 < timer_reload_remaining <= 4 at public save

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: CGB state round-trip seeds the accepted bus-error latch/address and stop-switch marker alongside valid non-default half-dot phases; no ordinary run-return reachability is claimed for these loaded representations.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: public loader accepts bus_unsupported=1/address=FF02, stop_switch_pending=1, divider_phase=1, and ppu_half_phase=1

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: The runner queues an A-button press at the next half-dot, advances through the public API, and saves after the event has changed the joypad projection.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: joypad_buttons contains the queued A press and the input event has been consumed

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: IRQ service pushes the return PC high byte to FF46 with SP=FF47, then the public run returns before the normal post-instruction DMA-start consumer.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: dma_start_pending == 1 after IRQ entry with SP crossing FF46 and before dma_start consumes it

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: CGB-only scene writes CGB registers, OAM, fine scroll and window registers, starts HBlank DMA, and saves during FIFO/window composition.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: ppu_fifo_count > 0 && ppu_window_started after visible mode-3/window scene

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Same original CGB-only scene saved at a separate measured HBlank DMA byte boundary so HDMA field coverage is distinct from the later window/FIFO boundary.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: hdma.active && hdma.byte_phase > 0 during an HBlank block

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Original CGB scene reaches an armed, not-yet-active HBlank transfer. A CRC-recomputed pending_hblank=1 state is admitted by the public loader and forked through future transfer output.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: hdma.mode == 1 && hdma.active == 0 && hdma.pending_hblank == 1 && hdma.blocks_remaining > 0

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Same original visible CGB scene saved while fine-scroll pixels remain to be discarded.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: ppu_mode == 3 && ppu_scroll_discard == 3

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Same original visible CGB scene saved during the window-induced mode-3 stall.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: ppu_mode == 3 && ppu_mode3_stall > 0 && ppu_window_started

generated_field_fixtures.purpose: Same original visible CGB scene saved between fetch phases while FIFO/window state is active.
generated_field_fixtures.boundary_predicate: ppu_fetch_phase == 1 && ppu_fifo_count > 0 && ppu_window_started

excluded.reason: Optional local corpus is rights-gated (G1) and its ROM bytes are absent.

in_flight_categories.predicate: locked && lockup_pc/lockup_opcode match the invalid instruction

mutant_policy: Every descriptor path with a non-default recorded witness is mutated once. Each mutant skips assignment while preserving one wire-width offset advance per element. A no-witness field needs a model-applicability or constant disposition with consumer evidence; it is not silently omitted.
